reason: A browser-only settings-panel search plugin that indexes available settings and navigates users to matching sections or highlighted rows using page-local UI state.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web 设置面板添加浏览器内搜索，可查找设置并跳转到对应分区或高亮具体设置项。
summaries.en: Adds an in-browser search field to the DSH Web Settings panel for finding settings and navigating to their sections or highlighted rows.

capabilities: Adds a browser-based search field to the DSH Web Settings panel
Indexes settings sections and visible setting rows
Navigates to and highlights matching settings
Reads the local slots service and settings DOM
Maintains page-local search state and registration data
